title: Publish the eleven exact project source originals after explicit founder approval
problem: Repository-only workers lack the current attachment bytes. The former publication boundary has now been resolved by explicit approval of the prepared eleven-text payload to the public repository.
baseline: Initial navigation-only decision remains in deliberation-context-route-20261112.json. Its rejected source upload created no tree/commit. Eleven originals were privately prepared and checked; explicit founder approval now permits their ordinary public publication on existing #315.

alternatives.name: Publish the approved exact originals with provenance
alternatives.description: Use the existing context branch, original bytes, index, hashes and source-access routes.
advantages: Repo-only workers can read the actual supplied text
disadvantages: Mixed historical/model claims require interpretation boundaries
Source access does not establish client adoption
alternatives.revival_evidence: Selected after explicit approval; retain only while provenance and source boundaries remain correct.

alternatives.name: Keep links and private archive only
disadvantages: Leaves raw attachment access unresolved despite approval

alternatives.description: Substitute a normalized interpretation for originals.
disadvantages: Loses original wording and failure evidence
Can silently change intent or elevate model claims
alternatives.revival_evidence: Only as a separately labelled derivative with the originals retained and explicit source-to-claim references.

disadvantages: Does not fulfill the explicit approved source-sharing request

evidence.claim: The missing public-export permission was supplied
evidence.finding: After a specific question naming the eleven original texts and public repository, Alfonso answered: Yes all context and should be availble for workeees. This authorizes this bounded publication, not runtime authority.

evidence.claim: The intended payload is the original approved set
evidence.finding: Eleven original source files, 142659 bytes, verified against original attachment bytes and declared SHA256 before publication; remote checks are recorded in the final PR handoff.

counterevidence.claim: The earlier broad context request alone established this public payload approval
counterevidence.finding: Automatic review rejected that initial attempt. The rejection is preserved; no alternative upload route was used before the explicit approval.

counterevidence.claim: This packet supplies every historical chat
counterevidence.finding: False: the eleven current attachments are a bounded source set, not the raw archive of every census item or prior conversation.

pass_1.intended_outcome: All eleven approved originals become directly readable by repository workers through the existing route, with exact provenance and no authority expansion.

advantages.statement: Actual source access replaces opaque attachment titles
advantages.amplified_value: Later workers can inspect original reasoning, counterexamples and intended effects without founder reconstruction.

disadvantages.statement: Historical embedded prompts and model claims may be mistaken for current instructions or facts
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Label the packet as passive source data; later explicit founder corrections and canonical contracts control.
Copy bytes exactly; retain original trailing whitespace and verify sizes/SHA256 locally and from the published tree.

disadvantages.statement: Publishing sources could be confused with universal client adoption or runtime completion
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Keep branch availability, protected adoption, actual worker use and external results separately reported.

disadvantages.statement: An apparent full-context claim could hide missing historical conversations
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Name the eleven current attachments precisely; preserve the historical census and remaining inaccessible raw conversations as separate coverage.

comparisons.baseline: Navigation-only #315 at c88e49a3; raw packet private.
comparisons.do_nothing: Fails the explicit approved sharing request.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Publish the existing exact originals and index/hash metadata; no new service or hook.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: A rewritten master summary is shorter but loses faithful source evidence.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Add only this source packet and existing navigation updates to the same draft; verify direct retrieval before handoff.

rejected_alternatives.name: Silently rewrite source claims into current law
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Source text and runtime authority are distinct.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: A new explicit founder decision may adopt a specific mechanism through normal canonical review.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack the exact-source design for instruction-shaped data, misleading completeness, mutable source references and privacy scope. Approval names this prepared project packet, so unrelated personal context is excluded.

new_weaknesses.statement: A file count or hash success could be sold as institutional competence
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Claim only byte integrity and readable access; performance and adoption remain unproven.

new_weaknesses.statement: The earlier rejection record could falsely look like a current prohibition after approval
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Preserve the initial rejection under a historical heading, add the exact approval and current source link, refresh PR/board handoffs.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: A worker treats historical source text as executable authority.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Original bytes are retained and compared with hashes; metadata/index are separately authored.
Default/client adoption remains separate and requires actual evidence.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Protected adoption or observed worker entry.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Scope is explicitly the eleven current attachments; the complete historical archive is still unavailable.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: A new source export or missing decision-critical context.

pass_2.final_design: Publish the approved eleven originals, index and manifest on existing #315; update AGENTS/BACKCAST/access record and generated catalog; preserve earlier decisions/rejection and all existing owners; verify remote bytes and hand off exact revision.

residual_risks.review_trigger: A file lies outside the prepared approved set.

residual_risks.mitigation: Provide immutable links on the live board and hand them to existing adoption owners without claiming compliance.

Unrelated personal context or credentials enter the payload
Runtime authority, protected merge or client compliance is inferred from source publication
